origin.description: Alias of assertPathForOutput. Returns the value when it is paths whose parent directory can receive a file. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.usage: assert_path_for_output(x, overwrite = FALSE, extension = NULL, .var.name = vname(x), add = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.text: When true, an existing file may be replaced.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

origin.details: Alias of assertPathForOutput. Returns the value when it is paths whose parent directory can receive a file. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
